solutions.title: Two stacks with lazy transfer
solutions.strategy: Push into an input stack and move elements to an output stack only when the output stack is empty.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value moves from input to output at most once before being popped.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Both stacks together store all queued values.

solutions.title: Costly push with front stack
solutions.strategy: Keep the oldest element on top by rebuilding the main stack on every push.

timeComplexity.explanation: A push may move every queued item twice; reads and removals are direct.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue contents live in one stack, with temporary movement during push.
